title: charles-mcp bridge event (schema_version 1)
description: One lifecycle event observed inside Charles's JVM, as served by the bridge `events` operation. URLs are as captured (the MCP sidecar redacts query secrets before any MCP client sees them). Additive fields may appear in v1; changing the meaning of a field requires schema_version 2.

event_id.description: Strictly increasing per bridge process. Use as a cursor.

session_id.description: Opaque id of the Charles recording session object ('none' if no session was attached).

transaction_id.description: Stable per bridge process across all updates of one transaction (e.g. 't42'). Null for session-level events.

event_type.description: Each maps to a ProxyListener callback; response_complete, failed and removed are terminal and occur at most once per transaction.

timestamp_ms.description: Wall clock (epoch ms) when the bridge observed the callback.

status.description: Null until response headers are known.

timing.description: Charles's own timestamps for the transaction at the time of the event.

error_type.description: Exception class simple name for failed transactions.
